messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Peregrine (enterprise, VPC, eu-west) — p99 latency > 2.0s for 12m across /v1/generate routes. Affected pool: pool-euw-ded-03. Pages routed to arthur (oncall). Runbook: https://console.redwood/runbooks/latency-p99
arthur (oncall): Ack, I’m on it. Paging runtime + infra. @sienna @maya can you triage?
maya: On my way. Pulling KV cache heatmaps and kernel selection logs. Starting a quick check on recent config changes.
sienna: Looking at pool-euw-ded-03 telemetry — batch size jumped, and CPU on the autoscaler leader is at 82%. No recent deploys in the last hour. Suspect noisy tenant causing backpressure.
lucas (support): Peregrine CS: they see UI slow for several customers, mostly longer prompts. No errors reported, just timeouts in client at ~8-12s. They asked if we have a temporary mitigation.
arthur (oncall): Good context. Two parallel actions: 1) isolate noisy tenant(s) in pool-euw-ded-03, 2) route Peregrine traffic to fallback model variant (latency-optimized) while we fix. Who can run eviction + route?
maya: I can do routing. Preparing command: `ri-route update --tenant peregrine --from model-xl --to model-xl-latopt --weight 1.0 --sticky 30m` — will flip after safety checks.
sienna: I’ll attempt tenant isolation on the pool. Plan: `ri-pool evict-tenant --pool pool-euw-ded-03 --tenant-id tenant-0xPEREG --grace 60s` then place tenant into warm spare pool-euw-warm-01. Dry-run logs show candidate nodes: node-23,node-24,node-25.
ops-bot: Autoscale trigger: +2 instances requested for pool-euw-ded-03, estimated provisioning ETA 90s.
maya: Routing change deployed to canary (10% traffic) — observed p99 drop from 3.9s -> 1.8s on canary. No errors. Rolling to 100% in 3m if stable.
lucas (support): Notifying Peregrine CS: temporary route to latency-optimized model, mitigation in progress.
sienna: Eviction started. One noisy tenant identified (tenant-0xNOISE) — evicted and pinned to warm spare. Post-evict pool p99 dropped to 1.7s.
arthur (oncall): Great. Confirming customer impact window: ~12m starting 5966666650 -> mitigation at 5966667790. Will open incident ticket and badge SLO breach.
emma (cs): I'll coordinate customer comms and offer a 10% usage credit. Drafting a short status: "We detected increased latency and have routed traffic to a latency-optimized model while we complete root cause work."
maya: Rollback plan prepared if routing causes regressions: `ri-route rollback --id <route-id>`; observed memory and kv metrics look stable post-mitigation.
sienna: Capturing traces for postmortem. Assigning follow-ups: root cause analysis (maya), autoscaler tuning (sienna), customer RCA with CS (emma).
arthur (oncall): Closing active war room — mitigation successful and service restored to SLO. Creating incident-XXXX ticket, will run full postmortem within 24h. Thx all. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-5966667777. Postmortem owner: arthur (oncall).
incident-bot: RESOLVED: Peregrine eu-west p99 latency — SLO restored. Duration: ~15m.
